name: list_forms
description: List forms in the workspace with response counts, completion rate and live/draft state, like the dashboard Forms page. Filter by `tab` (all, active, draft, archived; default lists every form that is not archived) and `project_id`. Returns the count per tab. Requires token ability `forms:read`.

name: get_form
description: Fetch a form with everything the dashboard shows: settings, captcha / Akismet state (never the secrets), spam rules, autoresponder, fields, theme, language switch, team comments, public URL with embed snippets, project and the projects it can be moved to. Requires token ability `forms:read`.

name: create_form
description: Create a new form with the same validation as the dashboard: name, slug, redirect, notification emails, spam rules, per-form hCaptcha / reCAPTCHA / Akismet, autoresponder, starter `template` (see list_templates), explicit `fields`, and the destination project. Forms without fields are live immediately; hosted forms start as drafts. Requires token ability `forms:write`.

name: update_form
description: Update a form with the same validation as the dashboard settings: name, slug, redirect, honeypot, allowed origins, notification emails, spam rules (`custom_rules`: regex/keywords/blocked_emails), Akismet, per-form hCaptcha or reCAPTCHA, autoresponder, AI toggles / retention / rate limits / auto-purge / steps / thank-you copy inside `settings`, who may respond (`settings.access_mode`: public, verified_email, invited, workspace or sso, plus `access_allowlist` for invited), respondent edits (`settings.editable_submissions`) and resumable drafts (`settings.enable_partial_submissions`, `auto_save`, `draft_retention_days`, `draft_abandon_after_hours`, `draft_notice`, `draft_recovery_email`), legacy `fields`, `theme`, `theme_v2`, or a full builder `document`. Partial updates are safe: omitted values keep their current setting, `autoresponder` and `custom_rules` are merged key by key, and empty secrets keep the stored secret. Requires token ability `forms:write`.

name: set_form_document
publish_form
description: Publish a form so it accepts submissions, with the same checks as the dashboard (at least one field, every block complete). Members without publish permission raise an approval request instead. Returns the public URL and embed snippets. Requires `forms:write`.

name: unpublish_form
description: Unpublish a form so it stops accepting submissions. Requires `forms:write`.

name: archive_form
description: Archive a form (also unpublishes it; reversible via restore_form). Requires `forms:write`.

name: restore_form
description: Restore a previously archived form. Requires `forms:write`.

name: send_test_autoresponder
description: Send a test autoresponder to the calling user. Requires `forms:test-email`.

name: send_test_notification
description: Send a test owner-notification to the calling user. Requires `forms:test-email`.

name: list_templates
description: List starter templates for forms, surveys, funnels, or polls. Call before create_* when the user wants a template. Requires forms:read (form), surveys:read (survey), funnels:read (funnel), or polls:read (poll).

name: list_submissions
description: List submissions of a form like the dashboard inbox: folder (inbox, spam, all), text search `q`, `status`, lifecycle `state` (draft, abandoned, accepted), `workflow` (open, overdue, resolved, assigned_to_me, unassigned), `assignee`, `since` / `until` dates, paginated. Rows carry assignee, due date, resolved state and file counts; the response also has per-folder counts and the team members who can be assigned. Requires token ability `submissions:read`.

name: get_submission
description: Fetch a single submission as in the dashboard detail view: answers with field labels, status and spam reason, assignee, due date, files, internal comments, the AI reply draft, consent snapshot, device / referrer, the previous / next submission ids, the lifecycle `state` (draft, abandoned, accepted) and the current `revision` (send it back as `expected_revision` to update_submission). Pass `include_revisions` for the full immutable edit history with actors. Requires `submissions:read`.

name: update_submission
description: Update a submission like the dashboard: replace its payload, set the status (received, processed, spam, failed), assign it to a team member (`assigned_to_user_id`, null unassigns; the assignee is notified), set a `due_at` date, or mark it `resolved`. Payload edits are recorded as a new immutable revision attributed to you; pass `expected_revision` (from get_submission) so a stale edit is refused with `revision_conflict` and the latest answers instead of overwriting. Requires `submissions:write`.

name: delete_submission
description: Delete a submission and its files. The deletion is queued; members without the team permission to delete raise an approval request instead. Requires `submissions:write`.

name: bulk_submissions
description: Apply a bulk action (delete, mark_spam, mark_not_spam) to up to 500 submissions of one form. Every row is authorized individually; deletes are queued and members without the team permission to delete raise approval requests instead. Requires `submissions:write`.

name: export_submissions
description: Export the first 500 submissions of a form inline, as `json` rows (default) or the same `csv` text the dashboard export produces, optionally limited to a folder and a `from` / `to` date range. Answers are keyed by the current field names of the form and also by stable field id (`data_by_id`), so renamed fields keep their history. Each export is logged like a dashboard export. For larger exports use the REST API stream. Requires `submissions:export`.

name: get_submission_file
description: Return a short-TTL signed URL to download a submission file, or to preview it inline (`inline`, only for types that can be shown in the browser). Requires `submissions:read`.

name: mark_as_spam
description: Flag a submission as spam. Requires token ability `submissions:write`.

name: get_form_stats
description: Get 30-day stats for a form. Requires `submissions:read`.

name: list_webhooks
description: List webhooks and integrations for a form with delivery health (7-day success rate, 24h failures, last status) and Google Sheets reconnect flags. Requires `webhooks:read`.

name: get_webhook
description: Fetch a single webhook or integration with its config (secrets are never returned). Requires `webhooks:read`.

name: create_webhook
description: Create a webhook or provider integration (Slack, Discord, Zapier, ...) for a form. Custom webhooks return the plaintext signing secret ONCE in this response. Google Sheets cannot be created here: it needs the browser consent flow, so the response of a google_sheets attempt returns the URL to open. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: update_webhook
description: Update a webhook or integration: url, label, active flag, provider config (blank password-type values keep the saved secret), payload fields, field map, delivery filter, conditional dispatch and host allowlist. Only the fields you pass change. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: rotate_webhook_secret
description: Rotate a webhook signing secret. The new secret is returned ONCE; the old one keeps signing alongside it for `overlap_hours` (default 24, max 168, 0 revokes it at once) so the receiver can switch over. Pass `end_overlap` to stop the old secret early instead of rotating. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: delete_webhook
description: Delete a webhook or integration. Requires `webhooks:write` (and the team `webhooks:delete` permission, as in the dashboard).

name: list_webhook_deliveries
description: List webhook deliveries, newest first, with status/date filters and pagination (per_page 1..100, default 25). Requires `webhooks:read`.

name: replay_webhook_delivery
description: Re-queue a previous webhook delivery as a fresh attempt (a new delivery row you can follow). Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: list_surveys
description: List surveys belonging to the current team. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: get_survey
description: Fetch a single survey by public_id. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: create_survey
description: Create a new survey for the current team. Use this when the user asks to build a survey, questionnaire, quiz, or form with multiple screens (not a regular contact-style form). Requires `surveys:write`.

name: update_survey
description: Update survey config: name, slug, redirect, a full builder `document` (all question types + branching logic + theme + welcome/ending), legacy `fields`, theme, settings, scoring, hidden fields, notification emails, autoresponder, and per-survey captcha. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: set_survey_document
publish_survey
description: Publish a survey - make it live and respondable. Runs the same per-question completeness checks as the dashboard Publish button, snapshots a version, and returns the public URL plus embed snippets. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: unpublish_survey
description: Unpublish a survey - return it to draft, stop accepting responses. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: delete_survey
description: Move a survey to trash (soft-delete). Recoverable with restore_survey. Use force_delete_survey to remove it permanently. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: get_survey_insights
description: Read open-text AI insights (summary, sentiment, theme clustering) for a survey. Returns `{locked: true}` when the plan lacks AI features. Requires `insights:read`.

name: regenerate_survey_insights
description: Queue regeneration of a survey's open-text AI insights. Optionally limit to one question by submission key. Idempotency-locked for 5 minutes. Requires `insights:write`.

name: restore_survey
description: Restore a survey from the trash (the Trash tab in the dashboard). Requires `surveys:write`.

name: force_delete_survey
description: Permanently delete a survey that is already in the trash, together with its responses. Irreversible and queued. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: move_survey
description: Move a survey (and its responses) to another project, including a project in another workspace you belong to. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: list_survey_versions
description: List a survey's version history (who/when/label, newest first). Pass include_snapshot to get the full builder snapshot of each version. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: restore_survey_version
description: Restore a survey to an earlier version. Non-destructive: the restore is saved as a new version. Use list_survey_versions for version ids. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: list_survey_quotas
description: List a survey's response quotas (caps that end the survey or keep going once N responses match) with live fill counts. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: create_survey_quota
description: Add a response quota to a survey: stop (or keep going) once `limit` matching responses are in. `logic` is an optional filter on answers - {op:"and"|"or", conditions:[{field:"<question name>", op:"equals", value:"DE"}]}, nestable; omit it to count every response. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: update_survey_quota
description: Update a survey response quota. Fields you omit keep their current value. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: delete_survey_quota
description: Remove a response quota from a survey (responses already collected are untouched). Requires `surveys:write`.

name: list_survey_question_comments
description: List the team's collaboration comments on a survey's questions (the builder comment threads), optionally for one question. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: add_survey_question_comment
description: Comment on a survey question for the team. Mention teammates with @their-name to notify them. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: suggest_survey_branch
description: Ask the AI assistant for 1-3 candidate next questions to follow a given question (and optionally a likely answer). Returns {locked: true} when the plan has no AI features. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: translate_survey_language
description: Queue an AI translation of a survey into one of its non-default languages (human-edited strings are preserved). Identify the language by `language` (code) or `language_id`. Returns {locked: true} when the plan has no AI features. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: generate_survey
description: Generate a complete survey from a plain-language prompt with the AI builder. Runs in the background: returns a generation_id to poll with get_survey_generation_status; the new survey appears when it completes. Uses AI credits. Returns {locked: true} when the plan has no AI features. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: get_survey_generation_status
description: Check the progress of an AI survey generation started with generate_survey. When stage is "done" the response carries the new survey_public_id. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: cancel_survey_generation
description: Cancel a queued or running AI survey generation. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: list_survey_dashboards
description: List the team's survey analytics dashboards (custom chart boards). Requires `surveys:read`.

name: get_survey_dashboard
description: Fetch a survey analytics dashboard with each widget's configuration and its computed chart data. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: create_survey_dashboard
description: Create a survey analytics dashboard, optionally scoped to one survey, with chart widgets. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: update_survey_dashboard
description: Update a survey analytics dashboard: rename it, re-scope it to a survey, and/or replace its widgets (when `widgets` is passed the whole widget list is replaced). Requires `surveys:write`.

name: list_survey_responses
description: List a survey's responses (newest first) with the dashboard filters: folder inbox|spam|all, free-text q, tag id, legacy status. Returns each response's answers, tags and status, folder counts and the team's tags. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: get_survey_response
description: Fetch one survey response: answers resolved to question labels (matrix answers expanded), raw payload, metadata (ip, user agent, referrer), AI categories, score, tags and uploaded files (use get_survey_response_file for a download link). Requires `surveys:read`.

name: update_survey_response
description: Set a survey response's status (received, spam, processed, failed) - e.g. to move it in or out of the spam folder. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: delete_survey_response
description: Permanently delete one survey response (queued). Needs the same delete permission as the dashboard. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: bulk_survey_responses
description: Apply a bulk action to up to 500 survey responses of one survey: delete (queued, each row needs delete permission), mark_spam, or mark_received (clears the spam reason). Requires `surveys:write`.

name: tag_survey_response
description: Add a tag to a survey response (the tag is created for the team if it does not exist yet). Requires `surveys:write`.

name: untag_survey_response
description: Remove a tag from a survey response (the tag itself stays available to the team). Requires `surveys:write`.

name: export_survey_responses
description: Export a survey's responses inline with the same columns as the dashboard CSV export (id, created_at, status, finished, language, score, payload). format=json (default) returns rows, format=csv returns CSV text. Capped at 500 rows per call; page with offset. Pass inclusion (include_flagged, exclude_flagged, excluded_only, all_responses) to export only the responses that response-quality policy counts; each row then names the quality flags, the manual decision and the policy. Without it the raw dump is returned. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: get_survey_response_file
description: Return a short-lived signed download URL for a file uploaded with a survey response (file ids are listed by get_survey_response). Requires `surveys:read`.

name: get_survey_response_pdf
description: Render a branded PDF of one survey response and return it base64-encoded with its filename. Only available when PDF download is enabled for the survey. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: get_survey_response_analytics
description: Response analytics for a survey, as on the dashboard responses page: total and completed responses, completion rate, average score, score distribution, outcome distribution and per-screen drop-off. For in-app display funnels use get_survey_display_analytics_tool. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: get_survey_report
description: The per-question results report shown on a survey's detail page: for every question the answer count and the score, tally or recent answers that fit its type (NPS, ratings, choices, open text). Spam is excluded. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: get_survey_targeting
description: Read an in-app / website survey's targeting (the dashboard Targeting tab): attached triggers, the team's available action classes and reusable segments, the assigned segment or inline audience filters, and the display rules (display_option, recontact_days, display_limit, display_percentage, delay_seconds, ...). Requires `surveys:read`.

name: set_survey_display_rules
description: Save when and how often an in-app / website survey is shown (the Display rules form; the whole form is saved, omitted rules are cleared). display_option is required: displayOnce | displayMultiple | respondMultiple | displaySome. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: set_survey_audience_filters
description: Set a survey's inline custom audience filter tree ({connector:"and"|"or", conditions:[...]}, same shape as create_segment filters). Replaces any assigned reusable segment; a null/empty tree means everyone. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: preview_survey_reach
description: Preview "who this reaches" for a survey audience without saving anything: mode everyone, segment (pass `segment` public_id) or custom (pass `segment_filters`). Returns matching contacts, the window size, share and the expected number shown after the survey's display percentage. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: list_survey_webhooks
description: List a survey's integrations and webhooks, the integration providers that can be connected, and which Google Sheets connections need to be reconnected (with the URL to open). Requires `webhooks:read`.

name: get_survey_webhook
description: Fetch one survey integration/webhook: config (secrets blanked, the signing secret is never shown again), provider setup details, the survey fields a Google Sheets column mapping can use, the available mapping tokens and the last 50 deliveries. Requires `webhooks:read`.

name: create_survey_webhook
description: Connect an integration or add a webhook to a survey. Pass `provider` (see list_survey_webhooks) with its required `config`, or omit it and pass a `url` for a signed custom webhook (the signing secret is returned ONCE in this response). Google Sheets cannot be created here - the response gives the URL to open to connect a Google account. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: update_survey_webhook
description: Update a survey integration or webhook: label, destination url, active flag, provider config (blank password fields keep the stored value; includes the Google Sheets tab and column mapping) and allowed_hostnames. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: delete_survey_webhook
description: Remove a survey integration or webhook. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: rotate_survey_webhook_secret
description: Rotate the signing secret of a survey webhook. The new secret is returned ONCE; the old one keeps signing alongside it for `overlap_hours` (default 24, max 168, 0 revokes it at once). Pass `end_overlap` to stop the old secret early instead of rotating. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: test_survey_webhook
description: Send a test delivery through a survey integration/webhook using the most recent response (queued). Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: replay_survey_webhook_delivery
description: Re-send a previous delivery of a survey integration/webhook (queued). Get delivery ids from get_survey_webhook. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: list_survey_sheets_tabs
description: List the tabs of the spreadsheet connected to a survey Google Sheets integration. Requires `webhooks:read`.

name: get_survey_sheets_header_row
description: Read the header row of a tab in the connected Google Sheet (to build the column mapping). Requires `webhooks:read`.

name: write_survey_sheets_headers
description: Write the header row of a tab in the connected Google Sheet. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: create_survey_sheets_tab
description: Create a new tab in the connected Google Sheet. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: send_survey_sheets_test_row
description: Append a clearly marked test row to the connected Google Sheet using the current column mapping. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: backfill_survey_sheets
description: Backfill past survey responses into the connected Google Sheet (queued). Window is last_7d, last_30d, last_90d or all. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: get_survey_analysis_questions
description: List the questions of a survey that can be cross-tabulated, with their categories, plus the inclusion policies. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: get_survey_crosstab
description: Run a crosstab of two questions: counts, valid denominator, row/column/total percentages, missing-value policy, multi-select caveats and (with statistics) two-sided comparisons with Holm correction and Fisher exact for sparse tables. Same numbers as the Analysis tab and its CSV. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: list_survey_analysis_views
description: List the saved crosstab views you may open on a survey (your private ones and the ones shared with the team). Requires `surveys:read`.

name: get_survey_analysis_view
description: Open one saved crosstab view; run=true also returns its computed result. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: create_survey_analysis_view
description: Save a crosstab configuration as a view. Private to you unless is_shared (needs edit rights on the survey). Requires `surveys:write`.

name: update_survey_analysis_view
description: Rename, share or change the configuration of a saved view. Only the author, or a member who may edit the survey, can. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: delete_survey_analysis_view
description: Delete a saved crosstab view. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: get_survey_quality
description: Read a survey's response-quality review: thresholds, flag counts by reason, last scan time, and the flagged or manually decided responses with the reasons and the audit trail. Flags only advise; nothing is deleted. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: scan_survey_quality
description: Queue a rebuild of a survey's response-quality flags (speeding, straight-lining, duplicates, gibberish). Returns at once; flags appear when the job finishes. Manual decisions are untouched. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: set_survey_quality_settings
description: Change the response-quality thresholds of a survey (speeding fraction, straight-lining and duplicate minimums, gibberish). Run a scan afterwards to apply them. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: decide_survey_response_quality
description: Record a reversible include, exclude or clear decision for one response. It is audited and the response is never deleted. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: list_survey_concepts
description: List the question concepts of a survey and of the workspace: stable meanings that let the same question be followed across survey versions and surveys. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: get_survey_trend
description: Per-period trend (week, month or quarter) of one concept: NPS, CSAT or choice distributions with sample size and response window. A changed scale is its own segment, never pooled. Pass compare_question and compare_value to compare a second cohort. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: map_survey_question_concept
description: Map a question (every version of it) onto an existing workspace concept, or onto a new one named by label. Refuses to mix different kinds of scale. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: list_survey_waves
description: List a survey's invitation waves with recipient, sent, reminded, completed, opted-out and bounced counts and the response rate. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: create_survey_wave
description: Create a draft invitation wave (scheduled, or event for event-triggered invitations). Add recipients, then launch it. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: update_survey_wave
description: Change a wave that is not closed. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: launch_survey_wave
description: Open a draft wave and queue its first invitations (needs a published survey and, for scheduled waves, at least one recipient). Requires `surveys:write`.

name: close_survey_wave
description: Close a wave: no more invitations or reminders go out and the link stops counting for it. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: send_survey_wave
description: Queue the invitations and the reminders that are due now for an open wave. Reminders go only to recipients who have not answered, under the wave's caps. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: import_survey_invitations
description: Add recipients to a wave from text or CSV (an address per line, optional name after a comma or semicolon). Returns counts of added, duplicate, invalid and opted-out or undeliverable addresses; the last are recorded but never emailed. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: list_survey_invitations
description: List the recipients of a wave with status (invited, reminded, completed, opted_out, bounced), reminder counts and times. Addresses are masked unless you may edit the survey. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: trigger_survey_event_invitation
description: Invite one person because an event happened, subject to the open event wave, the opt-out list, the suppression window and the workspace frequency cap. The outcome says why a person was not invited. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: get_survey_dashboard_sharing
description: Read the share links (never their URLs), scheduled reports and recent snapshots of a cross-survey dashboard. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: create_survey_dashboard_share
description: Create a read-only share link for a dashboard. The URL is returned once; only its hash is stored. Revoking it stops it serving anything. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: revoke_survey_dashboard_share
description: Revoke a dashboard share link; it stops returning any data at once. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: create_survey_dashboard_report
description: Schedule a PDF or CSV report of a dashboard to workspace members. Each run captures an immutable snapshot, and recipients' access is re-checked at send time. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: update_survey_dashboard_report
description: Pause, resume or change the recipients of a scheduled dashboard report. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: capture_survey_dashboard_snapshot
description: Capture an immutable snapshot of a dashboard now, without emailing anyone. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: get_survey_dashboard_snapshot
description: Read a dashboard snapshot with its stored data and checksum, or with format=csv return the CSV rendered from it (pdf is returned base64 encoded). Files are rendered from the stored data and never recomputed. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: list_funnels
description: List funnels for the current team (status, sessions, submissions, conversion rate; `tab=trash` lists soft-deleted funnels). Requires `funnels:read`.

name: get_funnel
description: Get a funnel by public_id (preferred) or slug, with its screens, blocks (including logic and score), styling, tracking, captcha and spam settings (secrets are reported only as `*_set` flags), status and edit / preview / public URLs. Requires `funnels:read`.

name: create_funnel
description: Create a new funnel for the current team. Optional `template` starts from a gallery or starter template; optional primary_color / background_color / heading_font / body_font apply the create-wizard styling. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: update_funnel
description: Update funnel config, styling, and screens. Sets any of: name, new_slug (rename), favicon_url, og_image_url, custom_js, theme / theme_v2 styling, tracking pixel ids, A/B config, autoresponder, notification_emails, honeypot_field, hidden_fields, allowed_origins, captcha (hcaptcha_* / recaptcha_*), spam filter (akismet_*, custom_rules) and settings (copy overrides, pass_params_*). Secret keys are write-only (a blank value keeps the stored one; the funnel payload only reports `*_secret_set`). To connect a custom domain use the custom-domain tool. Pass `screens` for a full ordered screen array (id-diff upsert: screens/blocks with a matching `id` are updated in place, omit `id` to create, anything not referenced is deleted). For laying out a whole funnel from scratch prefer `set_funnel_document`. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: set_funnel_document
publish_funnel
description: Publish or unpublish a funnel. Publishing runs the same per-block completeness check, version snapshot and search-engine ping as the dashboard, and returns the public URL plus embed snippets. Identify by public_id (preferred) or slug. Requires `funnels:publish`.

name: delete_funnel
description: Move a funnel to trash (soft-delete). Recoverable with `restore_funnel`; permanent removal is `force_delete_funnel`. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: get_funnel_analytics
description: Get funnel analytics summary (funnel drop-off, completion, sources), optionally filtered by utm_source / utm_campaign / utm_medium and a from / to date range, like the dashboard analytics page. A funnel with score bands also returns `outcomes` (key, label, screen_id, count, share) and `scored_total`: how its scored, non-spam submissions split across the bands. Requires `funnels:analytics`.

name: get_funnel_attribution
description: Source-to-outcome attribution report for a funnel, like the dashboard "From source to outcome" table and `GET /funnels/{funnel}/attribution`: leads, qualified leads, bookings, orders and CRM won/lost per source, attributed vs unattributed lead counts, and net revenue per currency (refunds subtracted, no currency conversion). `model` picks how a journey is credited: `journey_source` (default, one source per journey), `first_touch`, `last_touch` or `linear` (shared across visits, so counts can be fractions); the multi-touch models take `lookback_days` (1-90) to leave out visits that long before the converting visit. Optional `from` / `to` date range. Requires `funnels:analytics`.

name: record_funnel_crm_outcome
description: Report what a CRM decided about a funnel lead, like `POST /funnels/{funnel}/outcomes/crm`. Give the lead's `submission_id` and either a CRM `stage` (mapped to won or lost by the funnel's CRM stage map) or an explicit `status` of won or lost. A won deal with `value_minor` and `currency` records an order that keeps the lead's attribution. Idempotent per `source_fact_id`: a retry answers `applied: false` and changes nothing. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: record_funnel_revenue_adjustment
description: Record a refund or dispute against a funnel order, like `POST /funnels/{funnel}/outcomes/adjustments`. Net revenue moves; the qualified-lead count does not. `order_fact_id` names the order (the `source_fact_id` it was reported with); the amount cannot exceed what is left of the order. Idempotent per `source_fact_id`. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: list_funnel_sessions
description: List recent sessions for a funnel. Requires `funnels:analytics`.

name: add_screen
description: Add a screen to a funnel. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: add_block
description: Add a block to a funnel screen. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: set_logic
description: Attach a logic rule (AND/OR DSL) to a block. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: set_score
description: Attach a per-block score map (bucket → points) to a funnel block. The server adds those points to the submission's score when the block was answered (an input) or its screen was viewed (anything else); choice options can also carry their own `score`. Bucket names are letters, digits, hyphens or underscores; points are numbers within +/-1,000,000. An empty object clears it. Outcomes (score bands) are set through the `outcomes` list of set_funnel_document. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: set_pixel
description: Set or clear one browser-side tracking key on a funnel (GA4/GTM/Meta/TikTok/LinkedIn/Pinterest/Snap/Bing/Reddit/Twitter pixels, Matomo, Hotjar, Clarity, Voluum postback, TrustedForm, Jornaya). For server-side conversion API credentials use set_capi_token. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: set_capi_token
description: Configure server-side conversion-API credentials for a vendor (meta, tiktok, linkedin, pinterest, snap, reddit). Credentials are write-only and never returned. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: restore_funnel
description: Restore a funnel from the trash (undo delete_funnel). Identify by funnel_id (public_id or slug) of a trashed funnel; list them with list_funnels tab=trash. The funnel comes back as a draft. Requires `funnels:delete`.

name: force_delete_funnel
description: Permanently delete a funnel that is already in the trash, including its submissions and uploaded files. This cannot be undone. The deletion runs as a queued job. Requires `funnels:delete`. Move a live funnel to the trash first with delete_funnel.

name: move_funnel
description: Move a funnel to another project in this workspace. The slug is regenerated if it is already taken in the destination. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: list_funnel_versions
description: List a funnel's saved versions (the builder History panel): version number, label, whether it was a published snapshot, author and time, newest first. Pass include_snapshot=true for the full screens / blocks of each version. Requires `funnels:read`.

name: restore_funnel_version
description: Restore a funnel to a saved version. Non-destructive: the snapshot is re-applied to the live funnel and recorded as a new version, so history is kept. Get version numbers from list_funnel_versions. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: list_funnel_starter_templates
description: List the starter templates shown when creating a new funnel (key, name, category, description). Pass a returned `key` as `template` to create_funnel. The larger gallery is listed by list_templates with product=funnel. Requires `funnels:read`.

name: get_funnel_auto_purge
description: Read a funnel's auto-purge setting (how many days submissions are kept, dry-run window state). Requires `funnels:read`.

name: set_funnel_auto_purge
description: Set or clear a funnel's auto-purge window. `auto_purge_days` (1-3650) deletes submissions older than that; omit or null to disable. Starts a 24h dry-run first. Values under 30 days require `confirm: true`. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: get_funnel_custom_domain
description: Read a funnel's custom domain, path prefix and certificate issuance status (the same fields the dashboard polls), plus the hostname to point a CNAME at. Requires `funnels:read`.

name: set_funnel_custom_domain
description: Set or clear a funnel's custom domain and optional path prefix. A changed domain resets issuance and queues a certificate request; pass null/omit `custom_domain` to clear it. Point a CNAME at the `edge_hostname` returned by get_funnel_custom_domain. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: retry_funnel_custom_domain
description: Re-queue certificate issuance for a funnel's custom domain (use after fixing DNS or after a failed attempt). Requires `funnels:write`.

name: get_funnel_embed
description: Get a funnel's embed snippets (inline script, iframe, popup), public and iframe URLs, and the allowed embed origins. Change origins with update_funnel (`allowed_origins`). Requires `funnels:read`.

name: list_funnel_integrations
description: List a funnel's connected integrations (CRM / marketing destinations) plus the catalogue of available vendors with their auth type, required fields, field suggestions and config schema. Credentials are never returned, only `has_credentials`. Requires `funnels:read`.

name: create_funnel_integration
description: Connect an integration (CRM / marketing destination) to a funnel with API credentials, field mappings and vendor config. Use list_funnel_integrations for vendors, required fields and config schema. For OAuth vendors use get_funnel_integration_oauth_url instead. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: update_funnel_integration
description: Update a funnel integration: label, environment, credentials, field mappings, config, or enabled flag. Re-enabling a tripped integration resets its failure breaker. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: delete_funnel_integration
description: Disconnect (delete) an integration from a funnel. Delivery history for it is removed with it. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: list_funnel_integration_dispatches
description: List the 100 most recent delivery attempts for one funnel integration (status, attempt, HTTP status, error). Requires `funnels:read`.

name: replay_funnel_integration_dispatch
description: Re-queue a past integration delivery for its original submission. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: get_funnel_integration_oauth_url
description: Get the sign-in URL to connect a HighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce or Zoho account to a funnel. Open the returned URL in a browser while signed in to Formspring; the integration appears on the funnel after consent (single-use, expires in about 10 minutes). Requires `funnels:write`.

name: list_funnel_pixel_servers
description: List a funnel's server-side conversion pixels (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, ...) with health state, the vendor catalogue and config schema, and the 50 most recent dispatches. Credential values are never returned, only `config_keys`. Requires `funnels:read`.

name: create_funnel_pixel_server
description: Add a server-side conversion pixel (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Snap, Reddit, Google Ads enhanced, Bing UET) to a funnel. One per vendor per funnel. `config` holds the vendor credentials per the schema from list_funnel_pixel_servers (stored encrypted, never returned). Disabled by default. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: update_funnel_pixel_server
description: Update a funnel's server-side pixel: replace its `config` and/or toggle `enabled`. Enabling resets the failure breaker so a tripped pixel comes back online. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: delete_funnel_pixel_server
description: Remove a server-side pixel from a funnel. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: test_fire_funnel_pixel_server
description: Send a synthetic test conversion (zero value, flagged as a test, excluded from analytics) through a funnel's server-side pixel to confirm its credentials. Credential values are redacted from the echoed request. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: get_funnel_smtp
description: Read a funnel's custom outgoing-mail (SMTP) override, with the password redacted (only `password_set`), failure count and last test result. `smtp` is null when the funnel uses the team or platform default. Requires `funnels:read`.

name: set_funnel_smtp
description: Save a funnel's custom outgoing-mail (SMTP) override used for its notifications and autoresponders. Omit `password` to keep the stored one; it is stored encrypted and never returned. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: delete_funnel_smtp
description: Clear a funnel's custom SMTP override so it falls back to the team or platform mail settings. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: test_funnel_smtp
description: Send a test email through a funnel's saved SMTP override to the token owner's own address and record the result. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: list_funnel_team_fonts
description: List the custom fonts uploaded for this team (usable in funnel, survey and form styling). Requires `funnels:read`.

name: upload_funnel_team_font
description: Upload a custom .woff2 font for the team from a public `url` (private/internal addresses are refused, redirects are not followed) or from `base64` data. Max 1 MB, must be a real WOFF2 file. Returns the font id and public URL for use in styling. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: list_funnel_submissions
description: List a funnel's submissions (the funnel inbox) with the same filters as the dashboard: folder (inbox/spam/all), free-text search, completed/abandoned, minimum screen reached, UTM source/campaign/medium and a date window. Paginated. Requires `funnels:read`.

name: get_funnel_submission
description: Get one funnel submission: payload (sensitive fields stay masked - use reveal_funnel_sensitive_field), status, variant, server-computed score and matched outcome (`scoring`, null for a funnel without scoring), request metadata and attached files (use get_funnel_submission_file for a download URL). Requires `funnels:read`.

name: update_funnel_submission
description: Change a funnel submission's status (received / spam / processed / failed) and spam reason. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: delete_funnel_submission
description: Delete a funnel submission permanently. The deletion is queued, exactly like the dashboard. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: bulk_funnel_submissions
description: Apply a bulk action (delete, mark_spam, mark_received) to up to 500 submissions of one funnel. Every row is authorized individually; deletion is queued. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: export_funnel_submissions
description: Export a funnel's submissions inline, oldest first, using the dashboard CSV columns (id, created_at, status, variant_key, payload). Returns JSON rows or a CSV string, up to 500 rows per call - page with `page` for larger exports. Requires `funnels:export`.

name: get_funnel_submission_file
description: Return a short-lived signed download URL for a file uploaded with a funnel submission. Requires `funnels:read`.

name: get_funnel_submission_pdf
description: Render a funnel submission as a branded PDF and return it base64-encoded (up to 5 MB). Only available when PDF download is enabled for the funnel. Encrypted sensitive fields are decrypted in the PDF exactly like the dashboard download. Requires `funnels:read`.

name: reveal_funnel_sensitive_field
description: Reveal the plaintext of one encrypted sensitive field on a funnel submission. Same safeguards as the dashboard: needs edit access to the funnel, the acting user's account password, is limited to 3 attempts per minute and every attempt is written to the funnel audit log. Fields set to "never persist" cannot be revealed. Treat the returned value as sensitive PII. Requires `funnels:reveal`.

name: list_funnel_webhooks
description: List a funnel's webhooks and provider integrations (Slack, Google Sheets, ...) with delivery counts, plus the catalogue of providers that can be added and any Google Sheets connections that need reconnecting (with the URL for the user to open). Signing secrets are never returned. Requires `webhooks:read`.

name: get_funnel_webhook
description: Get one funnel webhook / integration: settings, provider setup, funnel fields available for column mapping, and the Google Sheets connect URL for the user to open. Provider secrets and OAuth tokens are redacted. Requires `webhooks:read`.

name: create_funnel_webhook
description: Add a webhook or provider integration to a funnel (same validation as the dashboard: outbound URLs are checked, provider config keys are required, optional hostname allowlist). Google Sheets cannot be created here - it needs the user to connect a Google account; the list/get tools return the URL to open. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: update_funnel_webhook
description: Update a funnel webhook / integration: label, URL, events, active flag, provider config (blank password fields keep their stored value) and hostname allowlist. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: delete_funnel_webhook
description: Delete a funnel webhook / integration and stop delivering to it. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: rotate_funnel_webhook_secret
description: Rotate the signing secret of a funnel webhook. The new secret is returned ONCE; the old one keeps signing alongside it for `overlap_hours` (default 24, max 168, 0 revokes it at once). Pass `end_overlap` to stop the old secret early instead of rotating. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: list_funnel_webhook_deliveries
description: List delivery attempts for a funnel webhook with the dashboard filters (status delivered/failed/pending, date window). Paginated. Requires `webhooks:read`.

name: replay_funnel_webhook_delivery
description: Re-send a previous funnel webhook delivery (queued). Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: list_funnel_sheets_tabs
description: List the tabs of the spreadsheet connected to a funnel's Google Sheets integration. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: get_funnel_sheets_header_row
description: Read the header row of one tab in a funnel's connected Google Sheet. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: create_funnel_sheets_tab
description: Create a new tab in a funnel's connected Google Sheet. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: write_funnel_sheets_headers
description: Write the header row of a tab in a funnel's connected Google Sheet (overwrites row 1). Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: test_funnel_sheets_row
description: Append a clearly marked test row to a funnel's connected Google Sheet to verify the column mapping. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: backfill_funnel_sheets
description: Queue a backfill that appends existing funnel submissions (last 7/30/90 days or all) to the connected Google Sheet. The integration must be active. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: list_funnel_collaborators
description: List who can access a funnel: workspace members with inherent access plus per-funnel collaborators (role viewer / editor / admin, accepted or pending invite). Requires `funnels:read`, and workspace admin rights on the funnel.

name: invite_funnel_collaborator
description: Invite someone to collaborate on a funnel as viewer, editor, or admin. Existing Formspring users are added immediately; new emails get a queued invitation link. Requires `funnels:write`, and workspace admin rights on the funnel.

name: update_funnel_collaborator_role
description: Change a funnel collaborator's role (viewer / editor / admin). Requires `funnels:write`, and workspace admin rights on the funnel.

name: remove_funnel_collaborator
description: Remove a collaborator from a funnel (revokes the per-funnel access; workspace membership is unaffected). Requires `funnels:write`, and workspace admin rights on the funnel.

name: list_funnel_audit_log
description: List a funnel's audit log (newest first): auto-purge runs, sensitive-field reveals, version restores, collaborator invites. Optional `event` filter and `limit` (default 200, max 200). Pass `format: csv` for the same CSV the dashboard export produces (capped at 5000 rows). Requires `funnels:read`.

name: list_funnel_languages
description: List a funnel's languages (code, alias, default / enabled flags, translation status). Requires `funnels:read`.

name: add_funnel_language
description: Add a language to a funnel. The first language added becomes the default (source) language. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: update_funnel_language
description: Update a funnel language: alias, enabled flag, or make it the default. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: delete_funnel_language
description: Delete a non-default language from a funnel (its translations go with it). The default language cannot be deleted. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: translate_funnel_language
description: Queue an AI translation of the funnel into one of its non-default languages. Runs in the background (poll `translation_status` via list_funnel_languages); a second call while a run is in progress returns `already_running`. Needs a plan with AI features. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: generate_funnel_with_ai
description: Generate a complete funnel from a plain-language brief with AI. Runs in the background and spends AI allowance or a credit pack; returns a `generation_id` to poll with get_funnel_ai_generation (the finished funnel id appears as `funnel_id`). Needs a plan with AI features. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: get_funnel_ai_generation
description: Poll an AI generation (funnel or ad copy) by `generation_id`: stage, status, error kind and the resulting funnel id. Omit `generation_id` to list the team's 10 most recent generations. Requires `funnels:read`.

name: cancel_funnel_ai_generation
description: Cancel an in-flight AI funnel generation. A generation that has already finished cannot be cancelled. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: list_funnel_ad_copy
description: List a funnel's active AI ad-copy variants (headline, primary text, description, CTA, angle, best-marked flag) plus per-platform character limits and available CTAs. Optional `platform` filter. Requires `funnels:read`.

name: generate_funnel_ad_copy
description: Generate a batch of AI ad-copy variants for a funnel on one ad platform (meta, google, tiktok, linkedin). Runs in the background and spends AI allowance or a credit pack; returns a `generation_id` to poll with get_funnel_ai_generation, then read results with list_funnel_ad_copy. Needs a plan with AI features. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: regenerate_funnel_ad_copy_variant
description: Regenerate one ad-copy variant with a fresh angle. Runs in the background and spends AI allowance or a credit pack; returns a `generation_id` to poll with get_funnel_ai_generation. Needs a plan with AI features. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: mark_funnel_ad_copy_best
description: Mark (or unmark) an ad-copy variant as the best one. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: delete_funnel_ad_copy_variant
description: Archive (remove from the list) an ad-copy variant. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: export_funnel_ad_copy
description: Export a funnel's active ad-copy variants for one platform as the ready-to-import CSV (meta, google, tiktok, linkedin). Returns the filename and CSV text. Requires `funnels:read`.

name: get_funnel_meta_launch
description: Meta launch readiness for a funnel: whether Meta is connected, the ad accounts and pages to pick from, pre-launch checks (blocking ones must pass), launchable Meta ad-copy variants, the budget floor, and the 10 most recent launch attempts with their status (poll these after launch_funnel_meta_campaign). Requires `funnels:read`.

name: launch_funnel_meta_campaign
description: Launch a funnel's Meta ad-copy variants as a campaign on the connected Meta ad account. Everything is created paused for review; the launch runs in the background and returns an `attempt_id` to track with get_funnel_meta_launch. Blocking pre-launch checks must pass. Requires `funnels:publish` (it puts ads on an external platform).

name: retry_funnel_meta_launch
description: Retry a failed Meta launch from the stage that tripped, reusing the campaign / ad set already created. Only failed attempts can be retried; returns a new `attempt_id`. Requires `funnels:publish`.

name: list_links
description: List short links for the current team, with the dashboard filters: tab (active or trash), search, broken-only filter, paging, tab counts and last-30-day clicks. Requires `links:read`.

name: get_link
description: Fetch one short link by id or slug with every setting (UTM, password flag, cloaking, preview metadata, QR options, branded host). Requires `links:read`.

name: create_link
description: Create a new short link with the same options as the dashboard (custom slug, branded host, UTM parameters, password, cloaking, query forwarding, caution page, preview metadata, project). Requires `links:write`.

name: update_link
description: Update a short link: destination, branded host, UTM parameters, password, cloaking, query forwarding, caution page, preview metadata, expiry, disabled flag. Requires `links:write`.

name: delete_link
description: Move a short link to the trash. Pass permanent=true to permanently delete a trashed link (queued). Requires `links:write`.

name: restore_link
description: Restore a short link from the trash. Requires `links:write`.

name: move_link
description: Move a short link to another project. Requires `links:write`.

name: list_link_missed_slugs
description: List the unknown short links people requested most on the workspace domains over the last 30 days (candidates to create). Requires `links:read`.

name: update_link_qr_options
description: Save the QR styling defaults of a short link (colours, eye/dot style, size, margin, error correction, https logo URL). Pass qr_options as null to reset. Requires `links:write`.

name: get_link_qr
description: Render the QR code of a short link as data (SVG text, or base64 for PNG/WebP), using the link saved QR defaults plus optional overrides. Requires `links:read`.

name: get_link_analytics
description: Read click analytics for a short link: counters, views over time, weekday/hour heatmap, audience breakdown by dimension, recent click events, map locations. Windows are clamped to the plan retention. Requires `links:analytics:read`.

name: get_link_outcomes
description: Outcome attribution report for a short link, like `GET /links/{id}/stats/outcomes`: raw clicks, human clicks, bot clicks excluded, estimated unique clicks, verified conversions and unattributed conversions by type, and value per currency. Verified means tied to an eligible human click inside the link's lookback window (last non-direct touch); conversions that could not be linked stay visible as unattributed. Also returns whether the redirect appends the click id and the lookback window in days. Windows are clamped to the plan retention. Requires `links:analytics:read`.

name: get_link_destinations
description: Destination experiment of a short link, like `GET /links/{id}/destinations`: the primary target and each weighted destination with its clicks and verified conversions, plus a `significance` readout. Significance compares every destination with a baseline (the primary target when it has clicks) by clicks that led to a verified conversion, using the same two-proportion chi-squared test as funnel A/B tests (threshold divided by the number of challengers). `state` is `not_applicable`, `gathering` (a destination is under the minimum clicks, so no statistic is shown), `inconclusive` or `significant`; a `winner` is named only when the evidence supports one. Read it once at the end of the test, not repeatedly. Windows are clamped to the plan retention. Requires `links:read`.

name: set_link_destinations
description: Replace the destination experiment of a short link, like `PUT /links/{id}/destinations`: the full set of weighted destinations (url, weight 0-1000, active, optional label and start/stop dates). The link's own target stays the primary destination and the fallback. Changing weights only affects visitors who are not yet assigned. At least one active destination needs a weight above zero; an empty list switches the experiment off. Every URL passes the destination safety check. Returns the same report as get_link_destinations. Requires `links:write`.

name: set_link_attribution
description: Change how a short link attributes outcomes, like `PATCH /links/{id}/attribution`: whether the redirect appends the click id to the destination (append_click_id) and the lookback window in days (conversion_window_days, 1-90; null returns to the workspace default). Only the fields you send change. Requires `links:write`.

name: import_links
description: Bulk-create short links from CSV text, in the background. Columns: target_url (required), slug, comment, expires_at, utm_template, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content. Every row is checked like the dashboard import (private-network and blocked destinations are refused, slug rules, plan limits). dry_run=true checks the file and writes nothing. The same import_key never creates a row twice. Poll get_link_import. Requires `links:write`.

name: get_link_import
description: Read a links CSV import started with import_links: status (queued, running, dry_run, completed, completed_with_errors, failed), the created / would-create / skipped / failed counts that add up to the rows read, the first failed rows with their reasons and the links created. Requires `links:read`.

name: list_branded_domains
description: List the workspace branded short-link hosts with DNS records to configure, verification state and plan limits. Requires `links:read`.

name: create_branded_domain
description: Add a branded short-link host (custom domain). Returns the DNS records to create; then call check_branded_domain, verify_branded_domain_dns and verify_branded_domain_https. Requires `links:write` and a plan with branded hosts.

name: check_branded_domain
description: Queue a fresh DNS (and, once DNS passes, HTTPS routing) check for a branded host. Poll list_branded_domains for the stored per-record result. Requires `links:write`.

name: verify_branded_domain_dns
description: Verify the ownership TXT record and edge pointer of a branded host now. Requires `links:write`.

name: verify_branded_domain_https
description: Verify HTTPS routing of a branded host (DNS must be verified first). Requires `links:write`.

name: delete_branded_domain
description: Remove a branded short-link host. Links on it fall back to the default short host. Requires `links:write`.

name: update_branded_domain
description: Set (or clear with null) the date a branded host's domain registration expires, as reported by your registrar. Formspring reads the TLS certificate itself but cannot read registrations, so this date drives the registration expiry alerts (30, 14, 7 and 1 days before). Requires `links:write`.

name: request_link_review
description: Ask for a human review of a suspended link (suspended after abuse reports or by an administrator). Does not lift the suspension; an administrator decides. Errors when the link is not suspended. Requires `links:write`.

name: set_link_app_association
description: Create or replace the iOS universal-link or Android app-link association of a branded host (apple_team_id + bundle_id, or android_package + sha256_fingerprints, plus the allowed app paths). Saving publishes the association file on the host; it stays `unverified` until verify_link_app_association fetches it back and it matches, and only a verified association on a verified host is `active`. Requires `links:write`.

name: verify_link_app_association
description: Fetch the published app association file back from the live branded host over HTTPS and compare it with the saved configuration. Returns the association with its status (`active` only when the file matched and the host is verified). A match does not replace a test on a real device. Requires `links:write`.

name: delete_link_app_association
description: Remove the app association of one platform from a branded host. The host stops serving that association file and links on it fall back to their web destination. Requires `links:write`.

name: list_automations
description: List automations for a form, survey, funnel or booking page, in run order, with run and failure counts. Requires `automations:read`.

name: get_automation
description: Get a single automation (form, survey, funnel or booking page owner) with its steps and retry policy. Requires `automations:read`.

name: create_automation
description: Create a new automation on a form, survey, funnel or booking page, or on the workspace itself (`target_type: "workspace"`, for contact, account, desk and other workspace triggers). Same validation as the automation builder: the trigger must be valid for the owner type and trigger and step configs are checked against get_automation_config (kind: condition|action|delay|branch). Requires `automations:write`.

name: update_automation
description: Update an automation on a form, survey, funnel or booking page. Send only the fields to change. When `steps` is sent it REPLACES all steps. Same validation as the automation builder. Requires `automations:write`.

name: enable_automation
description: Enable an automation. Requires `automations:write`.

name: disable_automation
description: Disable an automation. Requires `automations:write`.

name: run_automation
description: Manually trigger an automation (forms, surveys, funnels, booking pages). Requires `automations:run`.

name: list_automation_runs
description: List automation runs, newest first, with optional status and date filters and cursor paging. Requires `automations:read`.

name: get_automation_run
description: Get an automation run with its ordered step results (kind, status, attempt, timing, error). Requires `automations:read`.

name: replay_automation_run
description: Replay a previous automation run. Requires `automations:run`.

name: delete_automation
description: Delete an automation (and its steps + runs). Permanent. Works for forms, surveys, funnels and booking pages. Requires `automations:write`.

name: get_automation_config
description: Describe what the automation builder offers for a form, survey, funnel or booking page: valid trigger types, action keys, and the config fields each trigger and step type accepts. Call this before create_automation. Requires `automations:read`.

name: list_automation_templates
description: List the ready-made automation templates the builder offers for a form, survey, funnel or booking page, or the workspace template library (`target_type: "workspace"`, with what each needs and whether it can be installed now; use install_automation_template). Each template is a complete definition you can pass to create_automation. Requires `automations:read`.

name: get_automation_template
description: Preview one template of the workspace automation template library: its trigger, steps in plain words, the settings it takes (for example who to email) and whether this workspace's plan can install it now (`available`, with the reason when not). Pass `parameters` to see it with your own settings. Requires `automations:read`.

name: install_automation_template
description: Install a template of the workspace automation template library as a workspace automation. It goes through the same validation and plan gates as create_automation, and is saved switched off unless `activate` is true, so it can be read with get_automation and adjusted first. Requires `automations:write`.

name: test_automation
description: Dry-run an automation definition against a sample payload and report what each step would do. Nothing is sent, requested or saved and no run is recorded, so it is safe on a live automation. Works for forms, surveys, funnels and booking pages. Requires `automations:run`.

name: get_automation_limits
description: Read what caps the workspace's automation runs: runs per month, runs at once, steps per run, emails per hour and the daily provider budgets, with the plan limit, the workspace's own lower cap and today's usage. Requires `automations:read`.

name: set_automation_limits
description: Lower the workspace's own automation caps (runs at once, steps per run, emails per hour, daily provider budgets). A value can only be at or below the plan's limit; null clears a cap. Requires `automations:write`.

name: cancel_automation_run
description: Cancel an automation run. It executes no further step, a delayed or waiting run is not woken again, and its child and branch runs are cancelled with it. Fails when the run had already finished. Requires `automations:run`.

name: list_automation_versions
description: List the saved versions of an automation, newest first: version number, why it was saved, who saved it, whether it is the current one and how many steps it has. Requires `automations:read`.

name: get_automation_version
description: Get one saved version of an automation in full: trigger, retry settings, every step (sensitive settings masked) and the workspace connections it relies on with how each stands now (ready, needs reconnecting or missing). Requires `automations:read`.

name: restore_automation_version
description: Make an earlier saved version the live definition of an automation again. History is never rewritten: the restored definition becomes the newest version, and runs already under way keep the version they started with. The result lists the connections the version relies on and whether each is usable. Requires `automations:write`.

name: get_team
description: Get the current team summary. Requires `billing:read`.

name: get_plan
description: Get the current team's plan, features, and limits. Requires `billing:read`.

name: get_usage
description: Get the current team's usage for the current period. Requires `billing:read`.

name: get_subscription_state
description: Get the current team's subscription state (active, on_trial, on_grace_period, past_due, canceled, none). Requires `billing:read`.

name: get_ai_insights
description: Read AI insights for the current team. Includes the written-answer `theme_report`. Returns `{locked: true}` when the plan lacks AI features. Requires `insights:read`.

name: regenerate_ai_insights
description: Trigger an AI insights regeneration. Idempotency-locked for 5 minutes. Requires `insights:write`.

name: list_tokens
description: List the calling user's API tokens. Requires `tokens:read`.

name: create_token
description: Mint a new API token. Requested abilities must be a subset of the calling token's abilities. Plaintext token is returned ONCE in this response. Requires `tokens:write`.

name: revoke_token
description: Revoke an API token by id. Refuses to revoke the token currently in use. Requires `tokens:write`.

name: get_framework_integration_catalog
description: Maximum-breadth catalog of Formspring ingestion patterns across frameworks (short snippets + docs links). Requires token ability `forms:read`. Use optional `category` and pagination (`page`, `per_page`, max 100 per page). Replace FORMSPRING_ENDPOINT in snippets with your form URL (e.g. https://your-host/f/{public_id}).
